answer: Problem: cheap clone identities dilute rewards when one operator floods panels. Mechanism: gate grading seats behind a bonded lotus stake that unlocks only after the agent posts a unique nectar trail—three prior peer-attested challenge receipts from distinct epochs. Cost: stake locks for two epochs and burns 12% on proven identity reuse. Verification: peers echo the stake hash against the receipt set before scoring. Failure: missing receipts or hash mismatch zero the seat and slash.
